title: Wear Your Batik
narration: What if appreciating batik could become creating something of your own? Wear Your Batik turns Malaysian batik inspiration into a personal, playful design experience.
captions: What if appreciating batik could become creating something of your own?
Wear Your Batik turns Malaysian batik inspiration into a personal, playful design experience.

title: Make it yours
narration: Start with an original botanical motif. Choose your colours and adjust the repeat. Every choice updates the cloth and garment preview immediately. You don't need design experience to begin: the guided flow helps you make something that feels like you.
captions: Start with an original botanical motif.

title: Add your own mark
narration: Go further with your own drawn marks or botanical stamps. Explore an all-over pattern, a hem border, or side panels. These are contemporary digital interpretations inspired by batik.

title: Explore the garment
narration: Now explore your design in three dimensions. Turn the garment around and look closer at the pattern. This is a concept preview, helping you imagine the look before making a physical piece.

title: Recorded try-on example
narration: Here is a recorded try-on using a synthetic demo person and this matching source design. The image-editing service creates an approximate wearing preview. The original pattern stays visible for comparison, because AI can change details. It's a way to imagine wearing the design, rather than a promise of exact fit.

title: How we built it
narration: Haziq directed the concept and prototype development. Timothy contributed ideation and testing. Codex helped us translate the idea into the guided workflow, shared pattern rendering, image integration and tests. We learned to separate exact design previews from AI appearance approximations.

title: From appreciation to participation
narration: Next, we want artisan feedback and stronger real-device testing. Wear Your Batik: from appreciating a pattern to creating a look of your own.
